beats.name: hook
beats.said: Firing is impossible in Japan, but companies found something worse.
beats.shown: Hand-slammed FIRE button on a desk, nervous employee, then smiling boss behind a button.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Imagine boss leads you to tiny room: no computer, a clock, a guy on phone; job is nothing.
beats.shown: Office, door sign, empty desk, wall clock, man with feet up, boss holding red box.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Sit until six; you're paid for this; at first it's paradise.
beats.shown: Protagonist grins at desk, phone shows pay, lounging top-down.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Coworkers stare, emails stop, desk replaced, boss cheerfully checks in each Friday.
beats.shown: Open office, empty inbox, family photo, calendar, boss smiling in doorway.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: The corner guy seems happy, so you join him with feet up.
beats.shown: Man in corner, night tower window, two men relaxing with drinks.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: One Monday he is gone, desk cleared, nobody says where.
beats.shown: Empty desk and chair, coworkers standing, door.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: Law prevents firing but nothing prevents misery; they remove work and friends and wait.
beats.shown: Dark blue room, fire alarm with LABOR LAW tag, boss with mail cabinet.

beats.name: ending
beats.shown: Close-up of door sign; through window the lone worker sits at desk.

hook.first_frame: Blurred protagonist at a desk with a small red FIRE button on a green mat, blue Japanese-style room behind.
hook.first_3s: Camera swoops to the big FIRE button, a mallet smacks it with spark lines, then pulls up and back to the worried seated protagonist, then boss with closed eyes.
hook.first_frame_subject: protagonist posing with the key prop
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title promises an unwanted job; first line makes the claim that firing is impossible, then teases something worse.

story.real_fact_core: Japanese law makes firing hard, so firms use pressure-by-idleness 'banishment rooms' to push staff out.
story.protagonist: unnamed 'you' office worker with black hair, blue shirt, dropped into a room with nothing to do
story.authority_or_antagonist: smiling grey-haired boss in dark suit and red tie

tone.humour: Mild; cheerful boss and drinks-with-umbrellas lounging contrast with creeping dread.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Irony: paradise turns to isolation; smiling boss as villain; closing line is a flat moral.
tone.dialogue_style: Narrator in second person, fast and unbroken; no quoted speech.

animation.body_motion: Posed stick-limb figures with simple tweened gestures (lean, door peek, leg lift); big camera does most of the motion.
